evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Budh parvat par saaf, gehri vivah rekha — jeevan mein ek sachcha, pakka bandhan likha hai. Prachin niyam: sirf spashth rekha hi vivah/sthayi union ko darshati hai.

Venus mount accha ubhra hua (par bahut zyada nahi) — pyaar aur saath ki chaah, doosron ko khush karne ki ichha, aur har roop mein sundarta ki kadar. Artists, singers, musicians ke haath mein yeh mount hamesha dikhta hai. Aap warm, lovable insaan ho — yeh aapka sabse bada asset hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — Mount of Venus well-formed and not too large: desire for love and companionship, desire to please, worship of beauty; artistic emotional temperament; prominent in artists, singers, musicians

evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki hriday rekha gehri aur saaf hai — bhavnaon mein sthirta aur prem mein spashtata ka sanket. Jo mehsoos karte ho, poori tarah karte ho.

evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Cheiro ki parampara ke anusaar aapke janm-samay walon ko paani ke safar (nadi, samundar, boat, cruise) mein thodi extra saavdhani ki salah di jaati hai. Iska matlab darr nahi, bas tayyari: life jacket ka niyam maano, mausam dekh kar niklo, aur water-activity mein safety norms follow karo. Saavdhani hi shubh yatra ka asli tabeez hai.

evidence.interpretation_hi_en: Venus mount ke neeche haath ki badi khoon ki nali (palmar arch) hoti hai — Cheiro ke mutabik ubhra Venus = accha blood flow, strong circulation, robust health. Aapke paas natural stamina aur warmth hai; isse regular movement aur neend se maintain karo — yeh reserve khatam bhi ho sakta hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — Venus covers the 'Great Palmar Arch'; a large Mount indicates plentiful blood supply, strong active circulation, more robust health
